query:
SELECT lc.id, cc.nome, lc.valor, 
  (SELECT SUM(idi.custo) FROM item_despesa_importado idi WHERE idi.lancamentoCustoId = lc.id) as total_itens,
  (SELECT SUM(idi.custo) FROM item_despesa_importado idi WHERE idi.lancamentoCustoId = lc.id AND UPPER(idi.equipamentoTag) IN ('QMD 0H48', 'QMO6E54', 'QMD0H48', 'QMN1F10', 'SETOR RH', 'RRH 9F10', 'TNW 2I60')) as total_excluido
FROM lancamento_custo lc 
JOIN conta_custo cc ON lc.contaCustoId = cc.id 
WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = 60001 
ORDER BY lc.valor DESC 
LIMIT 15
